basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home in the vibrant Buena Vista Heights neighborhood, where urban living meets serene luxury! This beautifully renovated 2-bedroom residence with a den and 2.5 baths is a masterpiece by renowned architects Ewald and Pew, capturing the essence of San Francisco. As you step inside, you'll be captivated by breathtaking views of the iconic skyline and tranquil bay visible from nearly every room. The thoughtful design maximizes natural light, creating a warm & inviting atmosphere. With high-end finishes and an open-concept layout, this home seamlessly blends comfort and style. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary artist's dream, featuring top-of-the-line appliances, custom cabinetry, and a spacious islandperfect for hosting gatherings. The top-floor primary retreat boasts a dedicated home office, an expansive walk-in closet, and a spa-style bath with radiant floor heating for a touch of luxury. Downstairs, discover a versatile space with an entertainment bar, ideal for cozy movie nights or welcoming guests. Outside, multiple balconies, decks, & a charming garden invite you to savor quiet moments or entertain under the stars, all while soaking in spectacular views. Located just minutes from fantastic dining, shopping, and cultural attractions.
